This current episode differs critically from FAME-II because the Ministry of Heavy Industries is proactively engaging with market participants by specifically seeking granular sales estimates rather than relying solely on top-down budgetary targets, reducing policy friction. Furthermore, unlike the initial hesitation observed during early PLI formulations where capital commitments stalled, the current environment—highlighted by recent aggressive policy pushes like exemptions on high-tech imports and targeted value maximization in public sector enterprises—demonstrates an accelerated inter-ministerial alignment that bypasses historical bureaucratic bottlenecks, ensuring the e-bus and e-truck financing scheme will be formally notified well before the August 2027 deadline.
